Tips: Classification Rules

Priority

  • P0 — Crash / segfault / build failure / >5% perf regression / custom model blocker
  • P1 — UT >6 failures or regression / accuracy regression / hang
  • P2 — Benchmark issue / 1-6 UT failures / feature gap / correctness issue
  • P3 — Enhancement / minor issue / docs / nice-to-have

Category (first-match priority)

  1. Distributed
  2. Flash Attention
  3. Inductor
  4. TorchAO
  5. Sparse
  6. Torch Ops — gemm / eltwise / reduction / others
  7. Torch Runtime
  8. Others

Open Request (>1 week)

The action_TBD field is generated by analyzing related issue and PR comments, status, and activity. When a pending action item (e.g., waiting for reply, waiting for PR review, waiting for upstream fix) has been open for more than one week, it is tagged with (>1 week). Issues with at least one such tag are shown by default as they need attention; other issues are hidden behind the "Show hidden issues" checkbox.
